description: Department of Wildlife Conservation - Regulations made by the Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs under Section 71 of the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance (Chapter 460)
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance, amending previous regulations related to sea mammal observation. It establishes legal requirements, permits, fees, and conditions for observing sea mammals in specific maritime zones. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements under existing legislation.
